app-level.comparison-operator-without-value: value is required for every op except changed; XSD 1.0 cannot make one attribute depend on another
app-level.comparison-operator-with-empty-value: same as above: the value constraint depends on op
app-level.cond-without-tag-or-expr: a cond needs expr, or tag and op; XSD 1.0 cannot require one attribute or another
app-level.cond-with-tag-but-no-op: same as above: op is required only in the tag form
app-level.cond-with-both-expr-and-tag: the two forms are exclusive; XSD 1.0 cannot forbid an attribute combination
app-level.formula-that-does-not-parse: the schema cannot parse a formula
app-level.unknown-function: the function registry lives in formula.ts
app-level.unresolved-variable-reference: a name must resolve inside the rule; XSD 1.0 has no keyref into attribute text
app-level.variable-cycle: cycle detection needs the formula graph
app-level.reserved-variable-name: the reserved list is the function registry
app-level.condition-description-outside-a-then-fie: the context object is only defined while an action fires
app-level.then-field-formula-that-does-not-parse: the schema cannot parse a formula

xsd-stricter.empty-actions-next-to-an-incident: <actions> holds one or more <publish>; parse() maps an empty <actions/> to no actions
xsd-stricter.children-out-of-documented-order: the XSD fixes the order variables, condition, actions, incident; parse() accepts any order and serialize() always emits this order
xsd-stricter.variables-after-the-condition: same as above: <variables> comes first in the XSD; parse() accepts it anywhere
xsd-stricter.unknown-attribute: the XSD allows only the documented attributes; parse() ignores attributes it does not know
xsd-stricter.empty-optional-attributes: the XSD rejects "" for edge, cooldown, and device; parse() treats an empty attribute as absent
xsd-stricter.stray-content-the-parser-ignores: the XSD allows no text in groups and no children in <cond>; parse() skips text nodes and never looks inside <cond>
xsd-stricter.operator-with-surrounding-whitespace: the XSD enumeration is exact; canonicalOp() trims the token
xsd-stricter.description-on-a-folded-nested-leaf: the XSD allows a description on every <cond>; parse() folds a nested group into one row and drops the descriptions of its leaves. Accepted by both, listed here because the round-trip is lossy
xsd-stricter.description-on-the-top-level-group: the top-level group is the match mode, not a row, so a description there would be lost; the schema rejects it and parse() ignores it
